title: Combination Sum
prompt: Given an array of distinct integers candidates and a target integer target, return a list of all unique combinations of candidates where the chosen numbers sum to target. You may return the combinations in any order. The same number may be chosen from candidates an unlimited number of times.
hints: Backtrack: at each step, try adding each candidate (starting from current index to allow reuse). If sum exceeds target, return.
Base case: if target == 0, add current path to result. If target < 0, return.
Loop from start index to end: add candidate, recurse with target - candidate and same start (reuse), backtrack.
